value.rationale: Canonical first-order derivative-only sampling frame on cubical spherical nodes has an exceptional single blind harmonic in d=3 but becomes injective in every d≥4, despite large value-sampling blind subspace. Its complete sharp spectrum, dimension-nine change of maximizing mode and Θ(d²) squared-conditioning law determine exact stable recoverability; this is a motivated natural full family rather than an arbitrary finite slice.
